description: Create a ONE-OFF payment (checkout) with a hosted payment page, on either settlement rail — paid once, short-lived. For a dated or recurring payment link (a "cobrança": rent, tuition, an instalment), use `create_product` with kind="charge" instead. Default `payment_method: "pix"` — the payer pays a Pix QR in any bank app, and `payer_tax_number` (their CPF/CNPJ) is required. `payment_method: "depix"` — the payer sends DePix wallet-to-wallet on the Liquid network to the merchant's dedicated address: there is no Pix QR (the response carries `depix` instead of `pix`), no payer document is used, the merchant may grant a discount, and the payment is confirmed on-chain — `approved` at the first confirmation (~1 minute) and `completed` at the second (~2 minutes). The depix rail requires the merchant to have it enabled, otherwise the API answers `depix_not_enabled`. Requires scope `merchant_write`. Amount is BRL cents (the face value, before any DePix discount).

amount.description: Amount in BRL cents (R$5.00–R$6000.00). Wire field is `amount`.

amount_cents.description: Alias of `amount` (BRL cents). Provide either `amount` or `amount_cents`.

expected_discount_pct.description: `depix` rail only: the discount percentage (0–90) you already showed the payer. When it no longer matches the merchant's current discount the API answers 409 `discount_changed` with the fresh values, instead of silently charging a different price.

expires_in.description: Payment lifetime in seconds, per rail: `pix` accepts 300–1200 (default 1200); `depix` accepts 300–3600 (default 1800), because paying on-chain means opening a wallet.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. If omitted, the server generates one. Reuse to safely retry.

image_url.description: Optional image on the hosted payment page.

metadata.description: Optional arbitrary key/value bag echoed back on reads/webhooks.

payer_tax_number.description: Payer CPF/CNPJ (digits). REQUIRED on the `pix` rail — in all modes, including sandbox, while the platform tax-number gate is on. IGNORED on the `depix` rail: that rail has no payer identity by design, so this MCP does not even send the field.

payment_method.description: Settlement rail; defaults to `pix`. `pix`: the payer pays a Pix QR in any bank app. `depix`: the payer sends DePix wallet-to-wallet on Liquid to the merchant's dedicated address — no Pix QR, no payer document, an optional merchant discount, and settlement observed on-chain. `depix` requires the merchant to have the direct DePix rail enabled, otherwise the API answers `depix_not_enabled`.

name: create_checkout

amount.description: Charge amount in BRL cents (face value, before any DePix discount).

depix.description: DePix (Liquid) payment instructions — present on the `depix` rail only, while the checkout is still payable. An on-chain payment is irreversible.

address.description: Confidential Liquid address (lq1…) dedicated to this merchant's direct DePix receipts. In sandbox it is a non-payable placeholder — never send funds to it.

amount.description: The same amount as the decimal string a wallet signs (e.g. "89.91"). Transmit it verbatim; never round it.

amount_cents.description: EXACT amount to send, in BRL cents: the face amount minus the merchant's discount, minus a per-checkout adjustment of at most 99 cents (always downwards) that makes the value unique among the merchant's open checkouts. That uniqueness is how the payment is matched — any other value stays unattributed and is NOT credited automatically.

asset_id.description: Liquid asset id of DePix. Sending any other asset to this address loses the funds — they cannot be returned.

detected.description: true once a matching payment has been SEEN on the network but not yet confirmed. Informational only: the status stays `pending` and no webhook fires until the first confirmation.

discount_pct.description: Merchant discount applied on this rail, 0–90 (0 when the merchant offers none).

original_amount_cents.description: Face amount in cents before discount and uniqueness adjustment — the checkout's `amount`.

uri.description: BIP21-style Liquid payment URI carrying address, amount and asset — hand it to a wallet instead of asking the payer to type anything. Null in sandbox, which has no payable destination.

payment_method.description: The rail this checkout settles on. Absent on API versions older than 0.20.0 (read it as `pix`).

payment_url.description: Hosted payment page URL to hand to the payer.

pix.description: PIX payload — present on the `pix` rail only, while pending.

replayed.description: true when the API replayed a prior response for the same Idempotency-Key.

title: Create checkout
